sql: SELECT json_build_object('ai', (SELECT json_build_object('extra', s.extra_units, 'updated', s.updated_at, 'enabled', s.enabled, 'teste', s.test_mode_enabled) FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'), 'convs', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'unit', i.unit, 'created', c.created_at, 'step', c.bot_step, 'enabled', c.bot_enabled, 'ai', c.bot_data->>'ai_agent', 'lead', c.lead_id)) FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE c.remote_jid LIKE '%15996806890%' OR c.remote_jid LIKE '%1596806890%'), 'msgs', (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.ts) FROM (SELECT m.timestamp AS ts, m.from_me, m.message_type, m.status, left(m.content, 50) AS content, m.metadata, left(m.media_url, 80) AS media FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE (c.remote_jid LIKE '%15996806890%' OR c.remote_jid LIKE '%1596806890%') AND m.timestamp > now() - interval '6 hours') x))
